Subject: Quick demo request — GitHub app + OSS workflow

Hi Kimberly,

I signed up for Redwood this week (love the docs) and spun up a test repo connection — I'm a maintainer at Patchwork Labs and we're evaluating how Redwood could fit into our CI and contributor workflow. A short demo would be great to cover:
- OAuth GitHub app flow and org/repo permissions
- Webhook delivery guarantees and retry behavior for large contributor spikes
- Support for private repos and self-hosted runners
- Rate limiting and batching recommendations for webhook-heavy workloads

We started with the self-serve flow but would like a walkthrough and to understand where Dedicated/private deployments might matter for us. We're US-based (west coast). Availability next week is fairly open — mornings PT preferred.

Thanks — happy to share a repo link in advance.

Samira Costa
Lead Maintainer, Patchwork Labs
https://github.com/patchworklabs
